parsed.rationale: Regular rhythm with very tall R waves in V4–V5 (over 25 mm, off the grid) and deep S waves in V1–V3 (about 14–25 mm), so S(V1)+R(V5) is well above 35 mm; the ST elevation in V2–V3 is the expected secondary repolarization change of LVH, not STEMI, so this is not a normal tracing despite the team's impression.
